\[
z^2=\frac{(-1+\sqrt{3}i)^2}{4}=\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}.
\]
Therefore,
\[
z^3=z^2z=\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\cdot\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}=\frac{1+3}{4}=1.
\]
